versions.changelog: Release-standard compliance: README.md and LICENSE now ship in all 8 languages (EN/zh-CN/zh-TW/ko/ru/ja/es/fr); internals.md gained a multilingual index. No script changes.

SKILL.md image now uses an absolute URL (registry resolves relative paths against the page URL, which broke the screenshot on the skill page); added a license note that the bundled LICENSE is MIT-style with mandatory attribution.
Add real sidebar screenshots (Chinese + English UI) and link them from README/SKILL/说明.md so the badge style is visible at a glance. No script changes.

Fix: keep-alive no longer resurrects a badge that was already read and cleared by the gateway. The gateway agentStatus is now the authoritative signal (missing = cleared, never re-created); previously a read happening at/just before mark creation was misjudged as unread and the cleared badge reappeared ~90 min later.

Renamed to UnreadBadgeOpenClaw (old slug redirects). Full docs to release standard: 8-language README/SKILL/LICENSE/SPONSORS, Chinese guide, issue templates on GitHub, checksums, changelog. No script behavior changes.
Initial release: sidebar unread marks (flag/alert icon + timestamp note), auto-clear on read, 120min TTL with 90min keep-alive up to 7 days, silent-fail design.
